children.title: Cycle 140 · Interpreting Divergent Value Variance and Baseline Requirements

detail.title: Interpreting Divergent Value Variance and Baseline Requirements
detail.summary: Following the inconclusive result of the multi-agent value simulation in exp-divergent-values-test-73, we interpret the observed divergence score as a preliminary indicator that requires a control comparison against single-agent feedback loops to validate the hypothesis that multi-agent interactions drive measurable divergence. We revise the hypothesis and propose a comparative experiment.
